coordinate_bus_negative_control.note: These source lines do not satisfy the source-outside premise for this cut.

necessary_hypotheses: all ordinary public and extra local-copy data trajectories move only to containing charts
every downward/incoming transfer from outside the downset is one of the q counted V-dimensional packet trajectories
owned initializations and stationary caches are zero; no nonzero preloaded cross-chart data
physical trajectory identities persist through whole-(chart,value) role relabelings
retirement/rebirth creates a new counted descending lifetime
finite chronological linear operations over one common field and all endpoints exact
proof_audit.rank_argument: For one retained 8-frame, x_S starts outside U_S and all eight requested endpoints lie inside. The map from x_S to the at most q packet crossing vectors has rank <=qV. Every inside output is a linear image of those crossing values, while exact targets contain I_(8V); hence 8V<=qV.
proof_audit.all_volume: The same cut is applied to V-dimensional vector inputs; each packet crossing contributes at most V dimensions.
proof_audit.role_swaps: Whole-(chart,value) relabelings do not move a value across the cut. Any subsequently downward physical data trajectory is counted as another packet lifetime; free value-only exchange across distinct charts would invalidate the theorem and is excluded.
proof_audit.saturation: For q=8, each of the nine listed frame restrictions must have full stacked rank 8V at first packet entries. The exact B8 word meets these cut ranks but fails every diagonal target, so saturation is not sufficient.
limits: Does not establish existence or impossibility of a complete q=8 word.
Does not price rank or prove a full native/compiler/supplier result.
Does not cover uncounted downward copies, restarts, nonmonotone public routes, or nonzero cross-chart preloads.
